messages.author: f1a58f5e9789002f
messages.subject: Travis.ci + rstan
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm building a package that calls rstan. I'm having issues trying to run testing scripts on travis.ci that use the rstan function. It runs on my linux system with R v3.3.3 and rstan v2.14.1. For travis.ci, it installs, but breaks when it runs my tests, specifically for those that call rstan(). The output is the following:

Running the tests in ‘tests/testthat.R’ failed.
Last 13 lines of output:
         module_name = paste("stan_fit4", model_cppname, "_mod", sep = ""), verbose = verbose)
  11: cxxfunction(sig = sig, body = body, plugin = plugin, includes = includes, settings = settings, 
         ..., verbose = verbose)
  12: compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose)
  13: stop(paste("Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created!", paste(errmsg, 
         collapse = "\n")))


I've tried a bunch of travis.yml configs. The one that threw that error most recently had

language: r
sudo: required #false
cache: packages
warnings_are_errors: true
r:
  - release #3.3.0
  #- oldrel #3.2.5
  #- devel

r_binary_packages:
 - testthat
 - Rcpp
 - RcppEigen
 - Matrix

r_packages:
 - BH
 - StanHeaders
 - lda
 - stm

r_github_packages:
  - stan-dev/rstan
  - jyypma/nloptr
  - lme4/lme4
  - jimhester/covr

env:
  global:
    - _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_=false

after_success:
  - travis_wait 40 tar -C .. -xf $PKG_TARBALL
  - travis_wait 40 Rscript -e 'covr::codecov())'

notifications:
  email:
    on_success: change
    on_failure: always


I've tried the rstan dev version, as well as a few configs with clang, similar to this https://github.com/mjskay/metabayes/blob/master/.travis.yml

I looked through older posts but couldn't find anything recent, so I'm unsure if there's a solution or if I'm just bringing up an old problem. My hunch is it has to do with gcc 4.9 and R 3.3.X, see https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/307

Thanks.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Travis.ci + rstan
parts:
On Monday, April 3, 2017 at 5:23:56 AM UTC-4, Stephen Woloszynek wrote:
I looked through older posts but couldn't find anything recent, so I'm unsure if there's a solution or if I'm just bringing up an old problem. My hunch is it has to do with gcc 4.9 and R 3.3.X, see https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/307

My guess is that the binary version of R or Rcpp is compiled with g++-4.9 or later and it doesn't work on travis.ci when you try to compile models with g++-4.9. You could try installing Rcpp from source.

Ben

Thanks for all the help. I found the issue thanks to this thread: https://github.com/hadley/testthat/issues/86

Apparently I was getting that issue and it was only affecting my testthat script with inline/rstan in it. Once I added Sys.setenv("R_TESTS" = ""), inline works, and then rstan worked once I shifted back to my original tests.
